Tildes code block style uses triple tilde fences

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import CodeBlockStyle, ConversionOptions, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<pre><code>some code</code></pre>"
    options = ConversionOptions(code_block_style=CodeBlockStyle("Tildes"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
